blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence through three bounded product surfaces: spatially honest authored-arena traversal and camera framing, dense survivor-run performance/combat readability, and the ordinary run, upgrade, HUD, result, and retry lifecycle.

diagnosis.root_cause: The active high-angle camera still projects the Warden into the mausoleum/ground occlusion path, with prior evidence measuring only 0.2 visible ratio and identifying MausoleumCollision and GroundCollision as first occluders. Release convergence also lacks player-facing proof of dense-run stability and a complete ordinary run-to-result lifecycle.

stop_conditions: Preserve the intact authored cemetery package and native Godot boot/project baselines.
Do not schedule deferred backlog gaps or evidence-only implementation; host and Tester own recapture and verdicts.
Keep each task within its stated product family and stop after the three bounded implementation scopes.

strategy.rationale: Use three independent root-cause clusters matching the required gaps. Repair the active camera issue through explicit world/camera binding and occluder isolation rather than another local transform tweak; stabilize dense runtime lifecycle and causality; and complete the run/HUD shell with authored, accessible choices.

code: Run static/script and resource-load checks for all touched candidate paths; confirm no parse errors or new runtime errors.
Verify authoritative state transitions, XP/upgrade transaction, boss victory/failure, Result, Retry reset, pooling limits, and release-build guards.
runtime: Host recaptures the failed camera cells first, then spawn, critical route, cardinal landmark, and perimeter during ordinary movement and dash, checking collision, boundary, disappearance, and occlusion predicates.
Host runs the dense profile at representative spawn, route, and boss-adjacent views with runtime-state, frame-time, active-count, and combat-event evidence.
Host completes one ordinary successful route and one failure route, capturing upgrade focus states, HUD, boss/result, and Retry reset; Tester owns formal pass/fail and issue closure.
visual: Inspect the authored cemetery from shipped spawn, route, cardinal-landmark, and perimeter views for larger traversable scale, external depth, central landmark visibility, readable escape lanes, and no camera occlusion drift.
Inspect upgrade/weapon cards for silhouettes, compact icons, truthful current-to-new deltas, restrained copy, and distinct keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.
Inspect dense combat for stable readability of player, enemies, projectiles, VFX, HUD, boss telegraphs, and terminal screens without clutter or disappearance.

done_when: The active camera-occlusion reproduction is directly retestable: Warden and nearby threats remain readable before contact, near contact, and after departure around the central building/landmark during ordinary movement and movement replay.

The playable arena uses larger traversable scale (expand the route space as needed), with a coherent external world/external depth beyond the collision boundary/perimeter; collision and navigation align with native streets and no pass-through, disappearance, or occlusion occurs.

The central landmark remains visible and subordinate to play space from spawn, critical route, cardinal, and perimeter views; camera-aware sight lanes or selective bounded fading never hide the whole landmark.
The authored cemetery is retained as one intact runtime environment instance, with only additive collision, navigation, spawn, objective, and outer-datum anchors.
tasks.instructions: Repair the camera/world integration at the binding and isolation layer, not by repeating transform tuning. Inspect the preserved authored cemetery and ArenaCamera, then establish explicit outer datum, collision, navigation, spawn, objective, and perimeter anchors. Expand to a larger traversable scale while retaining external world depth. Reconcile the central building/landmark footprint, collision, navigation exclusion, and camera occlusion handling so ordinary movement and movement replay around every side preserve Warden, threats, escape lanes, and landmark visibility. Keep native streets, buildings, props, and materials authoritative.
tasks.title: Restore larger authored arena scale, camera framing, collision, and landmark visibility

done_when: A representative final-wave dense fixture sustains the intended enemy composition without runtime errors, unbounded node/audio/VFX growth, or unacceptable frame-time spikes.
Enemy spawning remains deterministic and safe: live caps, reachability, camera reveal margins, collision rejection, and recoverable escape directions hold under sustained movement.

Automatic combat remains causally readable at density: each attack resolves once, concrete hits drive damage/death/reward once, and player, enemy, projectile, impact, and pickup feedback remain distinguishable.
Restart returns active and pooled enemies, projectiles, pickups, particles, audio voices, timers, signals, pause state, and HUD state to a stable baseline.
tasks.instructions: Profile and harden the dense survivor-like path using bounded lifecycle ownership. Pool or cap high-churn enemies, projectiles, pickups, impact effects, floating labels, particles, lights, audio voices, navigation updates, targeting queries, and overlap checks where needed. Preserve attack ownership, legal deterministic targeting, hit/death causality, telegraphs, and readable crowd composition. Add candidate-owned counters/timings only to expose active, pooled, frame-time, and restart-baseline behavior for host validation; instrumentation must not replace runtime behavior.
tasks.title: Stabilize dense swarm performance and automatic-combat readability

done_when: One ordinary successful route progresses through wave milestones, XP collection, exactly one upgrade draft transaction, boss transition/defeat, victory, Result, and Retry without soft-locks; a separate failure route proves failure, Result, and Retry only.

Upgrade and weapon choices lead with authored silhouettes/icons, use compact stat icons, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, omit unchanged or exhaustive rows, and never show NEW/LOCKED as a CURRENT placeholder.

Level-up choices support complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, selected, unavailable, confirm, and cancel states with held-confirm debounce; the selected card changes authoritative build before gameplay resumes.

Gameplay HUD clearly presents health, experience/level, wave/run progress, equipped weapons/ranks, dash readiness, contextual boss health, objective state, and terminal Result/Retry affordances without covering the central arena.
tasks.instructions: Complete the authoritative run shell around existing gameplay: warmup, active waves, upgrade pause/resume, elite warning, boss transition, victory, failure, Result, and Retry reset. Verify XP overflow and exactly-once draft selection. Replace text-stacked cards with authored visual hierarchy and truthful deltas, and wire keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/activation. Keep tester-only preparation/advance hooks isolated behind a release-build guard if required for host recapture; they cannot substitute for ordinary play.
tasks.title: Complete ordinary run-to-result lifecycle and authored accessible HUD choices
